newsitem.title: FRANCE: French EDF electricity utility alters management.
newsitem.headline: French EDF electricity utility alters management.

text.p: French state electricity utility Electricite de France (EDF) said on Wednesday it had altered its management structure, making managing director Francois Ailleret vice-chairman with a greater say in strategic affairs.

EDF chairman Edmond Alphandery was altering the structure to appoint Ailleret and deputy managing director Pierre Duares as vice-chairmen with greater responsibility for strategic matters, said a statement from the group.
Ailleret would become chairman of EDF International, it said. Other changes included creating an executive directorate in charge of management, as well as setting strategy.
